notation_rules.24_hour_plus: IMD's explanation page states that times such as 25h and 26h mean 1 AM and 2 AM on the following Gregorian civil date (read directly by the reviewer). A printed time hh-mm with hh >= 24 on civil date D therefore means (hh-24):mm IST on D+1. printed_value and date_civil_as_printed are never changed; interpreted_ist_datetime and derived_instant_utc_minute are stored separately as deterministic arithmetic
notation_rules.central_station: Sunrise and sunset values apply to the IMD Central Station, 82 deg 30 min E, 23 deg 11 min N (stated on the explanation page, read directly by the reviewer). Never compare them with city coordinates
notation_rules.geocentric_endings: Tithi, Nakshatra, Yoga and Karana ending moments are geocentric and printed in IST = UTC+05:30 (explanation page, read directly by the reviewer); no city correction applies
